mapper.select: SELECT m.event_id AS eventId, m.kind AS kind, m.title AS title, m.message AS message, m.link AS link, (d.read_at IS NULL) AS unread, m.issued_at AS createdAt, d.read_at AS readAt FROM notification_delivery d INNER JOIN notification_message m ON m.event_id = d.event_id WHERE d.recipient_id = #{recipientId} AND d.read_at IS NULL AND m.issued_at < #{cursor} ORDER BY m.issued_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification_delivery WHERE recipient_id = #{recipientId} AND read_at IS NULL
